title: Objectives menu Is not visible
symptom: After installing the pumpcontrol apk latest version, everything works fine but the objectives menu is not visible and the user cannot unlock SMB loop.
cause: The app installed is only for pump control, not the full AAPS app, so it lacks the objectives menu.
fix: Build the signed APK for AAPS yourself following the instructions at https://androidaps.readthedocs.io/en/latest/Installing-AndroidAPS/building-AAPS.html, then install it and import the settings exported from the pumpcontrol version.
evidence_quote: This app is only for pump control. You need to follow instructions below and build the signed apk for AAPS yourself.
